_why: v3887 (#154, his 11-08: the characters 'should render the visual character ingame like .gif like we have for bosses/monsters ... so paladin is paladin ... render within each cell'; his reference: the classic animated class sprite). Each class's own idle loop from d2runewizard.com/classes (the site whose Banished loop he picked the same evening), one per class, its starting outfit and empty hands; each frame read cold by the Grok CLI (no names given) and matched to its class. A MAIN wears the same figure in a gold frame - no site serves a geared variant per class (measured 11-08).
